control.title: Security roles and responsibilities
control.description: Define and assign security and privacy roles (security lead, DPO or privacy contact, control owners) with a documented responsibility matrix.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.

requirements.title: Fit-and-proper management
requirements.guidance: Professional management, with promoters and directors meeting fit-and-proper criteria.

requirements.title: Structure, reporting lines and authority
requirements.guidance: Management defines org structure, reporting lines and responsibilities.

requirements.title: Accountability
requirements.guidance: People are held accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

requirements.title: Accountable senior executive (CISO)
requirements.guidance: A senior executive with security expertise, such as a CISO, is accountable for the policy and the cyber resilience framework.

requirements.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirements.guidance: Assign and communicate ISMS responsibilities, including who reports ISMS performance to management.

requirements.title: Accountability for all processing, including by processors
requirements.guidance: The Data Fiduciary remains responsible for compliance for processing it does and processing done on its behalf by Data Processors.

requirements.title: Management responsibilities
requirements.guidance: Managers require staff and contractors to follow security policies.
